description: This file defines a static class 'UnhandledCodeGenerationExceptionDiagnostic' that provides diagnostics for unhandled exceptions during code generation in the Orleans project. It includes diagnostic rule definitions and a method to create diagnostics from exceptions.

classes.name: UnhandledCodeGenerationExceptionDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic rules and methods for handling unhandled code generation exceptions.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object based on an exception, using the predefined diagnostic rule.
